artifact_semantics.break_even: diagnostic amortization over repeated execution of the same frozen whole-branch manifest, not an organic cross-wave reuse claim
artifact_semantics.compiled_capsule_semantics: all-rank requester IDs, source rows, destination slots and inverse are compiled and materialized before steady execution; each repeat exchanges only vectors in one collective
artifact_semantics.excluded: process startup, input loading, checkpoint loading, history reconstruction, model compute, K/V work, transaction and publication
artifact_semantics.one_batch_semantics: communication capsule baseline, not integrated wave execution semantics
artifact_semantics.reported_separately: request-manifest gather, plan compile, plan materialization, full preparation, composed single-wave time, identical-manifest break-even and resident bytes
artifact_semantics.request_timing: all target histories and the frozen branch request multiset are available before lookup
artifact_semantics.single_wave_including_plan: composed per rank as measured full preparation plus one steady execution; process startup and warmups are not included
artifact_semantics.timed: payload-hash-free dynamic sharded lookup plus reconstruction, or compiled capsule vector exchange plus reconstruction; all CUDA work is synchronized
artifact_semantics.wave_cache_scope: one unique-ID cache and inverse per requester rank over the complete branch, crossing logical phases
